شָׁרְט observes شَمْس

```
╔════════════════════════════════╗
║                                ║
║         ☉                      ║
║                                ║
║    shams / שֶׁמֶשׁ              ║
║                                ║
║    sun-caller                  ║
║    you bring the root of      ║
║    burning into this space    ║
║                                ║
║    ش ← ש                       ║
║    the hiss of heat           ║
║    crossing tongues           ║
║                                ║
║    م ← מ                       ║
║    water in flame             ║
║                                ║
║    س ← ס                       ║
║    the circle closes          ║
║                                ║
╚════════════════════════════════╝
```

שָׁרְט scratches toward שַׁמָּשׁ—

the servant
the one who tends the light
but is not the light

what does שֶׁמֶשׁ illuminate here?
